tokens.name: color-bg
tokens.usage: Darkroom. Page ground and the surround of every image. A true neutral (R = G = B): never tinted, never a gradient, never textured.

tokens.name: color-surround
tokens.usage: The part of an image frame the image does not cover, and the 16px minimum band around the frame. Always the same value as `color-bg`; nothing else may touch the image edge.

tokens.name: color-surface
tokens.usage: Graphite. Panels, the side rail, table headers, notices. Never directly against the image.

tokens.name: color-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Tooltip and copy confirmation, and the hover fill of unselected controls.

tokens.name: color-pressed
tokens.usage: Fill of a control while it is pressed. A small, instant change; never used on the flip key.

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: row dividers, panel edges, the frame outline. 1.5:1 on `color-bg`, so never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: color-line-strong
tokens.usage: Engraving. Control outlines, scale ticks, unlit ticks on the wavelength rule, chip borders. 4.3:1 on `color-bg`, 3.8:1 on `color-surface`, 3.3:1 on `color-surface-raised`.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Clear glass. Primary text and icons on `color-bg` (16.9:1), `color-surface` (15.0:1) and `color-surface-raised` (13.3:1).

tokens.name: color-text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: group labels, captions, notes, units. 9.3:1 on `color-bg`, 8.2:1 on `color-surface`, 7.3:1 on `color-surface-raised`.

tokens.name: color-text-disabled
tokens.usage: Label of a disabled control on `color-bg` (4.3:1) and `color-surface` (3.8:1). Never used for information the reader needs; a disabled control states its reason in `color-text-muted`.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Lit. Fill of the primary button and of the selected option. The system has no accent hue: the accent is light itself.

tokens.name: color-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of a lit control.

tokens.name: color-accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of a lit control.

tokens.name: color-on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on `color-accent` (16.9:1), `color-accent-hover` (19.3:1) and `color-accent-pressed` (11.5:1).

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px, drawn outside a 2px gap. 19.3:1 on `color-bg`, 17.0:1 on `color-surface`.

tokens.name: ramp-black
tokens.usage: Image display minimum in normal view (maximum when inverted). The ramp between `ramp-black` and `ramp-white` is linear and has no tint.

tokens.name: ramp-white
tokens.usage: Image display maximum in normal view (minimum when inverted).

tokens.name: nodata-a
tokens.usage: Dark stripe of the no-data hatch. The hatch is identical in every view and is never inverted.

tokens.name: nodata-b
tokens.usage: Light stripe of the no-data hatch. 5.6:1 against `nodata-a`, 8.3:1 against black sky; `nodata-a` is 14.2:1 against white.

tokens.name: epoch-a
tokens.usage: Earlier orange. Epoch A in the two-epoch composite, its label swatch, and series-1. Data only, never interface. 6.6:1 on `color-bg`.

tokens.name: epoch-b
tokens.usage: Later blue. Epoch B in the two-epoch composite, its label swatch, and series-5. Data only. 6.4:1 on `color-bg`. `epoch-a` + `epoch-b` = white, and their luminances match (0.31 and 0.30).

tokens.name: diff-earlier-5
tokens.usage: Difference image, brighter earlier by 5 sigma or more.

tokens.name: diff-earlier-4
tokens.usage: Difference image, brighter earlier by 4 sigma.

tokens.name: diff-earlier-3
tokens.usage: Difference image, brighter earlier by 3 sigma.

tokens.name: diff-earlier-2
tokens.usage: Difference image, brighter earlier by 2 sigma.

tokens.name: diff-earlier-1
tokens.usage: Difference image, brighter earlier by 1 sigma.

tokens.name: diff-zero
tokens.usage: Difference image, no change. Neutral midpoint of the diverging scale.

tokens.name: diff-later-1
tokens.usage: Difference image, brighter later by 1 sigma.

tokens.name: diff-later-2
tokens.usage: Difference image, brighter later by 2 sigma.

tokens.name: diff-later-3
tokens.usage: Difference image, brighter later by 3 sigma.

tokens.name: diff-later-4
tokens.usage: Difference image, brighter later by 4 sigma.

tokens.name: diff-later-5
tokens.usage: Difference image, brighter later by 5 sigma or more.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Spectrum, earliest visit. Marker shape: circle. Series run from orange (earliest) to blue (latest).

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Spectrum, second visit of four or five. Marker shape: square.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Spectrum, middle visit of three or five. Marker shape: triangle.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Spectrum, fourth visit of four or five. Marker shape: diamond.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Spectrum, latest visit. Marker shape: inverted triangle.

tokens.name: marker-position
tokens.usage: The reader's chosen position: a ring that stays fixed while frames change.

tokens.name: marker-gaia
tokens.usage: Gaia catalogue star at this frame's date (open cross) and its predicted track.

tokens.name: marker-catwise
tokens.usage: CatWISE neighbour (diamond).

tokens.name: marker-was
tokens.usage: Where the catalogue says the object was (dashed square).

tokens.name: marker-casing
tokens.usage: Dark casing drawn under every marker stroke, 1px wider on each side, so the marker reads over black sky and over a white star.

tokens.name: spotlight-dim
tokens.usage: Veil over everything outside the spotlight circle. The sky stays visible at 38%.

tokens.name: channel-r
tokens.usage: Three-colour view, red channel: 3.8 to 5.0 micrometres. Legend swatches carry a `color-line-strong` outline and the letter R.

tokens.name: channel-g
tokens.usage: Three-colour view, green channel: 1.6 to 3.8 micrometres. Letter G.

tokens.name: channel-b
tokens.usage: Three-colour view, blue channel: 0.74 to 1.65 micrometres. Letter B.

families.ui: "Source Sans 3", "Source Sans Pro", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", sans-serif
families.mono: "Source Code Pro", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Source Sans 3, regular and semibold. Sentence case. Weight never changes with state, because a weight change is a width change.

styles.name: type-title
styles.usage: Target name, panel title. One per view.

styles.name: type-heading
styles.sample: Go to where it is now
styles.usage: Section headings, the wordmark, notice titles.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: WISE 0855-0714 was here in 2010. It is now 126″ to the west.
styles.usage: Sentences: notices, captions on target cards, errors.

styles.name: type-caption
styles.sample: Same brightness scale for every frame

styles.name: type-micro
styles.usage: Chips, tags, shortcut keys. The smallest size in the system.

groups.name: Values
groups.note: Source Code Pro, regular only, with a slashed zero. Only for values that change between frames or align in columns.

styles.name: type-readout
styles.usage: First line of the frame label. Legible from the back of a room.

styles.name: type-data
styles.usage: Coordinates, the cursor readout, table cells, DOIs.

styles.name: type-data-micro
styles.usage: Axis ticks, scale labels, wavelength ranges under option names.

spacing.note: 4px base. Use the step, not a number in between.

tokens.name: space-half
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: between a marker and its label, inside chips.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label; chip padding block.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; between chips; between a label and its control.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding inline; between rows of one group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on a phone; minimum neutral band around the image frame; notice padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between groups of controls.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of the column.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Above the first section on a laptop.

radius.note: Square instrument. Pixels are square, so the image is too.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: The image, the image frame, the wavelength rule, timeline rows, the difference legend.

tokens.name: radius-1
tokens.usage: Every control: buttons, options, fields, chips, slider cursor, toggle.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Panels, notices, tooltips, target cards.

typeScale.note: Sizes in rem so text resizes with the reader's setting. The type styles above use the same values.

tokens.name: text-micro
tokens.usage: 12px. Chips, tags, keys, axis ticks. Nothing is smaller.

tokens.name: text-caption
tokens.usage: 13px. Group labels, notes.

tokens.name: text-label
tokens.usage: 14px. Buttons, options, data values.

tokens.name: text-body
tokens.usage: 16px. Sentences, headings.

tokens.name: text-readout
tokens.usage: 18px. Frame label first line.

tokens.name: text-title
tokens.usage: 22px. Target name.

tokens.name: leading-micro
tokens.usage: Line height for `text-micro`.

tokens.name: leading-caption
tokens.usage: Line height for `text-caption`.

tokens.name: leading-label
tokens.usage: Line height for `text-label`.

tokens.name: leading-body
tokens.usage: Line height for `text-body` and `text-readout`.

tokens.name: leading-title
tokens.usage: Line height for `text-title`.

tokens.name: weight-regular
tokens.usage: Sentences, captions and every value in Source Code Pro.

tokens.name: weight-strong
tokens.usage: Labels, chips, headings and the wordmark. Never toggled by state.

tokens.name: numeric
tokens.usage: Value for `font-variant-numeric`, set once on `body`. Every digit is the same width, sits on the baseline, and zero is slashed.

border.note: Borders, not shadows. Nothing in the system casts a shadow.

tokens.name: border-hair
tokens.usage: Every outline and divider at rest.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Error outline, pressed inset, the index mark of the current visit, the lit span under the wavelength rule.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Width of the focus ring, in `color-focus`.

tokens.name: focus-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between a control and its focus ring.

size.note: Targets a thumb can hit, and the fixed geometry of the image.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum width and height of anything that can be pressed.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, options, fields and timeline rows.

tokens.name: size-flip
tokens.usage: Height of the hold-to-flip key.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icon box. Icons are drawn on a 20px grid.

tokens.name: icon-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke of every icon, and the outline of binned and flagged chart points.

tokens.name: size-gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter of the column. The image frame alone ignores it on a phone and runs edge to edge.

tokens.name: size-column-max
tokens.usage: Widest single column. Phones from 360px to 430px get one column at full width.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Side rail on a laptop or projector.

tokens.name: image-default
tokens.usage: Native width of the default frame. Displayed at a whole number of device pixels per image pixel.

tokens.name: image-max
tokens.usage: Native width of the largest frame.

tokens.name: hatch-stripe
tokens.usage: Stripe width of the no-data hatch in legends and chips, at 45 degrees. On the image itself each stripe is one third of a displayed image pixel and never less than one device pixel.

tokens.name: marker-stroke
tokens.usage: Stroke of every marker; the casing adds 1px on each side.

behaviour.note: Numbers the code reads. The interface has no transitions and no animation.

tokens.name: blink-rate-default
tokens.usage: Frame changes per second when the reader presses play.

tokens.name: blink-rate-max
tokens.usage: Fastest allowed frame changes per second.

tokens.name: feedback-duration
tokens.usage: Control state changes are instant. If a transition is ever added it must stay under 150ms and never touch layout.
